# eveOps Group

> eveOps Group is a parent company with two divisions: Unity Integrated Solutions for professional services, and eveDev Ops for software, AI, and digital products.

The public site is https://eveopsgroup.cloud. The company name is written eveOps Group. Email is support@eveopsgroup.com. Phone is +237 671 361 513.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/): What the group is, and the two divisions.
- [Unity Integrated Solutions](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/unity): Professional services. Language, transcription, AI data, research, virtual workforce, content operations, and procurement.
- [eveDev Ops](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/edevops): Software engineering. Web, mobile, software, AI, automation, cloud, application security, and APIs.
- [Work](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/products): Published work from both divisions.
- [Shweng](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/products/shweng): A cross-network exchange application in development. It is not launched.
- [Journal](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/insights): Technology and business questions, notes, and short tutorials. Visitors can ask a question and reply in writing or with a voice note.
- [Contact](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/contact): How to start a conversation.
- [Privacy](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/privacy): What the site does with information.
- [French home](https://eveopsgroup.cloud/?lang=fr): The same site in French.

## Facts

- Form messages are stored for the team and can be emailed when mail is configured. They are not kept only in the browser.
- The public site does not use advertising or analytics cookies.
- Do not invent client names, revenue, headcount, a street address, or certifications.
- Do not present Shweng as a launched product.
- A page, a PDF, or a form is not a contract, a price, or a start date.
